plan.name: Marathon in 5h00: 16-week plan
plan.description: 16 weeks, 3 runs a week, to run a marathon in 5h00 (7:07/km). Written for a VMA around 11.5 km/h. Week 1 is about 22 km; the biggest week reaches 43 km and the longest run lasts 2h55. Every session has its targets: a share of VMA for easy runs and intervals, your goal pace for race-pace work.

cycles.name: Base
cycles.description: Easy volume, short fast reps and strides. The long run grows a little each week. Week 4 is lighter, to absorb the work.

sessions.name: Fartlek
sessions.description: 15 min warm-up, 6 × (1 min fast at 92–97% VMA / 1 min easy), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Easy run + strides
sessions.description: 40 min easy (62–70% VMA), then 6 strides of 20 s: fast but relaxed, walk back between them.

sessions.name: Long run
sessions.description: 1h30 at an easy, even pace (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: 30/30 intervals
sessions.description: 15 min warm-up, 10 × (30 s at 100–105% VMA / 30 s jog), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Long run
sessions.description: 1h45 at an easy, even pace (62–70% VMA).
